description: This is a Java unit test source file for testing the InstallmentDelinquencyAggregator class within the Apache Fineract project. It contains test cases for aggregating and sorting installment delinquency data, ensuring correctness of the aggregation logic.

classes.name: InstallmentDelinquencyAggregatorTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that verifies the correct behavior of InstallmentDelinquencyAggregator's aggregation and sorting logic for delinquency data.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes tenant context and rounding mode before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Restores original tenant context and clears cache after each test.

methods.name: testAggregateAndSort_emptyInput_returnsEmptyList
methods.description: Tests aggregation with empty input; expects empty result list.

methods.name: testAggregateAndSort_singleInstallment_returnsSameInstallment
methods.description: Verifies that a single input installment returns the same after aggregation.

methods.name: testAggregateAndSort_twoInstallmentsSameRange_sumsAmounts
methods.description: Checks that two installments in the same range have their amounts summed.

methods.name: testAggregateAndSort_threeInstallmentsSameRange_sumsAllAmounts
methods.description: Ensures multiple installments in the same range are correctly aggregated.

methods.name: testAggregateAndSort_twoInstallmentsDifferentRanges_remainsSeparate
methods.description: Confirms installments in different ranges are kept separate.

methods.name: testAggregateAndSort_multipleInstallmentsMixedRanges_aggregatesAndSeparatesCorrectly
methods.description: Verifies correct aggregation and separation across multiple ranges.

methods.name: testAggregateAndSort_sortsByMinimumAgeDaysAscending
methods.description: Checks that results are sorted by minimum age days ascending.

methods.name: testAggregateAndSort_complexScenario_aggregatesSortsCorrectly
methods.description: Validates complex scenario with multiple ranges and amounts.

methods.name: testAggregateAndSort_nullMinimumAgeDays_treatsAsZero
methods.description: Ensures null minimum age days are treated as zero during aggregation.

methods.name: testAggregateAndSort_decimalPrecision_maintainsPrecision
methods.description: Checks that decimal precision is maintained during amount summation.

methods.name: testAggregateAndSort_zeroAmounts_includesInResult
methods.description: Verifies that zero amounts are correctly included in result list.
